name: Globule
description: Globules at three sizes, each one nearly round and none of them quite.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; @size: @pick(44%, 66%, 90%); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: @repeat(4, @rand(38%, 62%)) / @repeat(4, @rand(38%, 62%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
